canonical_claim: A one-dimensional standard Brownian motion admits a version of its local-time field L(t,a), jointly continuous in time t and level a, such that almost surely, for every time t and every nonnegative Borel function f, the time integral of f(B_s) over s from 0 to t equals the integral over real a of f(a) L(t,a).
